sample_unit: benchmark items (counterfactual vignette ablations, ~23,000 per pronoun variant)

links.outcome: Stability of GPT-4.1 reasoning traces across counterfactual pronoun variants (STS)
links.effect: Overall high similarity (mean STS >0.80), but consistent localized divergences in cited risk factors, guideline anchors, and differential ordering, even when final diagnoses remain unchanged.
links.quote: Our results show overall high similarity (mean STS >0.80), but reveal consistent localized divergences in cited risk factors, guideline anchors, and differential ordering, even when final diagnoses remain unchanged.

unlisted_practices: Counterfactual benchmark auditing of reasoning-trace stability (not only final outputs) under pronoun/gender perturbations

screen.reason: The study evaluates demographic biases and reasoning stability of an LLM across counterfactual clinical vignettes (pronoun perturbations), but does not test an organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
